question: What did the son of Soma abandon when he departed with Kauśāṅgī?
premises: He abandoned the kingdom of the gods.
He abandoned the king of the gods.
inference: The son of Soma himself abandoned the divine kingdom and its king and went with Kauśāṅgī.
plain_english: Having abandoned the kingdom of the gods and the king of the gods, he himself went together with Kauśāṅgī.
